Digital Marketing / Martech.title: OpenAI API Only Partly Matched ChatGPT Citations, Paper Finds
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A research paper tested whether Google results and the OpenAI API can serve as proxies for ChatGPT citations, finding they matched cited sites more often than the exact pages. This has implications for enterprises trying to use the API as a stand-in for measuring ChatGPT citation coverage.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Updates AI Mode and AI Overview with More Links, Context, Carousels, and Information on Creators
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has updated both AI Mode and AI Overviews to surface more links, additional context, carousels, and creator information within AI-generated answers. These changes directly affect how enterprise content is surfaced and attributed in AI answer surfaces.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Pushes Links Higher in AI Answers as Preferred Sources Use Rises 7x
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has moved links to more prominent positions within AI-generated answers, and use of the Preferred Sources feature has reportedly risen significantly. This signals a structural shift in how publishers and enterprise sites can earn visible attribution in AI Overviews.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT Appears to Drop UTM Tracking, Making AI Referral Traffic Harder to Measure
AI Search / GEO.summary: ChatGPT appears to be stripping UTM parameters from referral traffic, making it harder for marketers and SEOs to accurately attribute visits originating from AI-generated answers. This is a direct measurement challenge for enterprise teams tracking AI search channel performance.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Now Pays 400 Publications to Feed AI Features in Google News
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google is paying 400 publications to supply content that powers AI features within Google News, indicating a formal content-licensing layer now underpins some AI answer surfaces. Enterprise publishers and travel media should assess eligibility and implications for editorial content strategy.

AI Search / GEO.title: Optimizing Visibility in Generative Engines: A Critical Survey of Generative Engine Optimization (2023-2026)
AI Search / GEO.summary: An academic survey covers the evolving field of Generative Engine Optimization, reviewing research and strategies for improving content visibility across generative AI search systems from 2023 through 2026. It provides a research-grounded reference for enterprise GEO practitioners building structured optimization approaches.

AI Search / GEO.title: When Optimization Becomes Manipulation: Defending Generative Search Against Malicious Generative Engine Optimization
AI Search / GEO.summary: This paper examines the boundary between legitimate GEO practices and manipulative tactics that could exploit generative search systems, with implications for how AI search platforms may evolve their defenses. Enterprise SEO teams should be aware of emerging guardrails that could affect aggressive AI-visibility strategies.
